## Visual notes

(one-time model pass 2026-07-02; regenerate index with --keep-notes to preserve)

### Pixel Crawler - Free Pack 2.1 — Floors_Tiles.png (384x288)

Checkered floor palette with 3 color schemes (green/tan, brown/tan, tan/brown) arranged in 32px grid. Top rows show 8-tile-wide patterns; middle rows display rounded stone/tile floor variants (light blue, orange) at approximately (col 0-1, row 4-6); bottom row solid color blocks. Plain floor: green or brown checker at (0,0). Suitable for tavern, dungeon, or dirt interior floors.

### Pixel Crawler - Free Pack 2.1 — Wall_Tiles.png (384x288)

Three vertical color columns (tan/brown, gray-blue, dark brown/olive), each 3 tiles wide. Each shows multiple wall style variants (stone/brick texture, plank wood, solid blocky). Top ~2 rows per color: decorative wall patterns; middle rows: solid wall blocks with dark shading; bottom rows: platform/sill tiles. Solid wall example: any middle-row block. Palette emphasizes earth tones and cool grays, 32px per tile.

### Pixel Crawler - Free Pack 2.1 — Dungeon_Tiles.png (336x400)

Complex mixed-theme tileset. Top-left (0-5, 0-6): dark metallic/stone walls, teal corridor walls. Center-top (6-9, 0-4): white door frames and green foliage. Right side (9+, 0-4): brown wooden walls and doors. Bottom-left (0-4, 12-16): red brick/lava tiles; bottom-right (4-8, 12-16): blue and green special tiles. Plain dungeon floor at approximately (10, 8) olive-brown; walls at (0-5, 8-12) dark gray stone.

### Pixel Crawler - Free Pack 2.1 — Interior_Props_01.png (608x384)

Comprehensive interior furnishings atlas. Upper rows: sofas (2 tiles wide), beds, tables, chairs, cabinets, stoves (double-wide), shelves, barrels. Mid-section: doors, windows (blue glass, wood variants), wardrobes, cabinets with detail. Lower sections: potted plants (small clustered at ~col 1-2), decorative items, vessels, small props. Palette: brown/tan wood predominant, blue glass accents, earth tones. Useful for inn/tavern interior design.

### Pixel Crawler - Free Pack 2.1 — Furniture.png (800x864)

Scattered furniture component sheet. Left column (col 0-2): tall bed frames, wardrobes, shelves stacked vertically. Central area (col 2-5): doors, windows with panes in various orientations, lanterns, barrels, tables. Right area (col 6-10): decorative heads, shields, armor stands, small vessels. Bottom: large decorative wheel/crest, parquet floor patterns. Primarily browns and tans with red/dark accents. Good for picking individual pieces or small decor groups.

### Pixel Crawler - Free Pack 2.1 — Esoteric.png (400x400)

Magical/alchemical item sheet concentrated in top-left quadrant. Rows 0-4: potion bottles (4 frame variants per bottle type), stacked grimoire books, crystalline orbs, runes (small 16px), and glowing vials. Remaining area sparse. Palette: cool teals, purples, golds on potions; dark leather/paper books; gem sparkle highlights. Useful for inventory icons or shelf decoration; each potion type ~32px tall.

### Pixel Crawler - Cave — Assets/Tiles.png (272x304)

Cave/fungal environment tileset. Upper area (col 0-2, row 0-5): dark rocky spore formations (brown/black, scalloped edges suggesting fungal growth). Mid area: red/orange coral or lava fragments (3 variants). Lower area: solid olive-brown and dark green floor/vegetation. Approximately 8-10 tiles across, 9 rows down. Plain cave floor: olive-brown solid at (col 1-2, row 7). Walls/rocks: any brown/black formation at top. Organic, subterranean palette.

### Pixel Crawler - Free Pack 2.1 — Body_A Idle_Down-Sheet.png (256x64)

Player character idle animation, 4 frames facing down. Each frame ~64x64px. Simple retro style: brown-haired humanoid in tan/beige tunic. Frames show slight bobbing/breathing animation (1-2 pixel vertical shift). Frame 1: neutral pose; frames 2-4: chest/shoulder rise suggesting respiration. Suitable for standard tavern patron or generic player avatar.

### Pixel Crawler - Free Pack 2.1 — Citizen_F Idle_Down-Sheet.png (256x64)

Female NPC idle animation, 4 frames down-facing. Same 64x64px frame size and bobbing animation as Body_A. Character has longer/darker hair, tan/brown dress/clothing in similar palette. Frames show consistent breathing cycle. Useful for tavern barmaid, innkeeper, or generic female townsperson.

### Pixel Crawler - Free Pack 2.1 — Tavern_02.png (1344x1792)

Complete multi-room tavern mockup floor plan. Central main hall (col 8-21, row 5-20) dominates: open dining with ~15 tables, red lantern posts marking sections, NPC sprites scattered. Left wing (col 0-7): kitchen area with stoves, prep tables, storage. Top-right (col 15-21): upstairs balcony dining with servers. Street level below (col 8-21, row 20-24): shopfront storefronts, exterior. Bottom: 3 private rooms (separate views) with beds and furniture variants (blue, green, red bedding). Each room ~8 tiles wide. Demonstrates full inn layout suitable for open-world tavern reference.

### Bat_Fur — Idle_Down-Sheet.png (384x96)

Bat creature idle animation, 4 frames facing down. Frame size ~96x96px. Reddish-brown fur with darker wing/body outline. Simple bobbing animation similar to humanoid idles. Suitable for flying pest enemy or cave wildlife. Palette: rust red body, dark burgundy accents.

### Pixel Crawler - Hideout — Baldits Fighter Idle-Sheet.png (256x64)

Bandit/enemy soldier idle animation, 4 frames. Frame size ~64x64px. Green-skinned humanoid (orc-like) in armor/gear, facing down. Simple bobbing animation. Suitable for generic humanoid enemy (bandit, hired thug, goblin). Palette: pale green skin, dark armor/leather.
